panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 3 panels (A, B, C). A: Real patient clinical photograph illustrating the ultrasound evaluation for pneumothorax with a 13 MHz linear transducer; it demonstrates the scanning technique rather than a diagnostic image, so no vocabulary finding can be assigned, but it is a genuine patient image tied to the target disease context. B: Split-screen B-mode and M-mode lung ultrasound in a patient with pneumothorax: arrow marks the immobile pleural line without lung sliding and the M-mode trace shows the horizontal barcode/stratosphere pattern, classic sonographic signs of pneumothorax.
